newsitem.title: UK: Commercial Union up on takeover talk.
newsitem.headline: Commercial Union up on takeover talk.

text.p: Shares in Commercial Union were marked higher in early trading as talk of takeovers in the insurance sector continued to swirl, dealers said on Fiday.
Commercial Union Plc shares were up 10 pence, or 1.42 percent, to 712.5p by 0735 GMT in volume of 165,000.
The FTSE-100 index was 18.0 points, or 0.40 percent, lower at 4,427.0 after the opposition Labour Party's landslide election win.
"There's follow-through buying from yesterday's (Thursday) talk of a takeover (in the sector)," a marketmaker at a British bank said.
Commerical Union shares rallied 20p on Thursday.
B.A.T Industries Plc has been rumoured to be preparing the disposal of its financial businesses which include Allied Dunbar and Eagle Star.
B.A.T shares were down 4p (0.77 percent) to 513.5p on minimal volume of just 35,000.
